title: Native coefficient transport and compact-support comparison data
statement: Fix a prime l. NativeRings specifies the commutative native locally finite coefficient ring on each scheme and its inverse images, normalized by precomposition on functions. NativeGeometry adds the exact additive section equivalences and native direct-image, inverse-image and open-extension comparisons, normalized by identity on sections and the specified adjunction mates. actual is the native open extension followed by proper derived direct image for a chosen compactification. properTransport and operationTransport are the canonical derived section comparisons. For a finite-field datum D, l != D.p, a separated finite-type relative morphism f between finite-type schemes over D.k (without absolute separatedness), a coefficient construction P over the lifted PadicAlgCl, and a compactification c, StageAction is a morphism of the original unlifted common-field stage systems whose functors and scalar comparisons are the specified P rational operations and q. IntegralNormalization is precisely the original six-arrow proper/open scalar-mate equation on every integral finite-Tor representative. CompactSupportComparison bundles three realizations, this stage action, the compatible coefficient maps, a common-stage natural isomorphism with that normalization, and preservation of native bounded constructibility. These are the unchanged definitions formerly located in the item module.
